about: workflow:choose-which-ai-answers-me: keeps which AI answers the person, or automatic routing, as one choice in the person's own store. It replaces the request-building tool tool:choose-which-ai-answers-me in tools/selected-agent (run/, tool-rows.json), which sent the choice to a retired workflow slot (rule a-tool-is-only-what-the-store-cannot-do).

payload.label: Choose which AI answers me
payload.job: Keep which AI answers the person, in the person's own store: one choice, the id of the AI, or the empty choice that sends the person back to automatic routing. A choice that is not text is refused in words. Reading gives the choice as it is kept, or automatic when none is kept yet. The choice is the person's own; an AI may keep it only when the person has asked for it.
payload.produces: The one kept choice, read back as an AI id or as automatic; proven on the same six example steps in PostgreSQL, a markdown folder and a JSON file, with the same answers in each.
payload.source: tools/selected-agent (do-work/set-selected-agent.ts and run/plan-selected-agent.mjs, its kit kits/choose-which-ai-answers-me.json). The request the old tool built was sent to the retired workflow slot of the old runtime; the recipe keeps the choice in the person's own store instead. The screen that offers the choice (packages/selected-agent/show) stays with its owner, see the commit message.

where.description: Where the person keeps this choice: the store's own address

language.description: How that store is spoken to

credential_name.description: The name in the person's vault under which the store's login is kept

agent_id.description: The AI to answer the person, or "" for automatic routing; leave out to read the choice

steps.title: Read what the store already keeps
steps.do: Speak to the store in its own language, with the login under its credential_name, and read its own description of what it holds. Submit where the choice is kept (kept_in, or null) and the names of the objects that keep it.

steps.title: Make the store's own object, once, and keep the choice
steps.do: When the look step found nothing, make the store's own object in its own form: one row holding the one choice, with a key that allows one row only. To keep a choice: refuse, in words, any agent_id that is not text (the message says: give the id of the AI to answer, or "" for automatic routing); otherwise replace the row with the new choice, where "" means automatic routing. A read returns the kept choice, or automatic when no row exists. Submit the names of the objects made, or the ones the look step found.

steps.title: Prove the choice on the example steps
steps.do: In a throwaway place in the same store, with the same object, run these six steps in order and record each outcome and answer: (1) read before any choice: automatic. (2) keep agent:sample-writer: kept. (3) keep "": kept, automatic. (4) keep the number 5: refused. (5) keep agent:sample-writer again: kept. (6) read back: agent:sample-writer. Submit outcomes (one per step, in the words given: automatic, kept, kept, refused, kept, agent:sample-writer) and answer (the choice read back at step 6, and the refusal words given at step 4).

checks.says: Each step has the outcome the rule gives
The store's read-back and refusal words give the expected answers

values.refusal: Give agent_id: the id of the AI to answer, or "" for automatic routing.

payload.erase: On the person's request the store deletes the kept choice, and the choice reads as automatic routing again.
